weakness.title: Insufficient Physical Security Monitoring
weakness.description: The facility does not adequately observe its spaces and assets, or the observation has no effect, so unauthorized presence or activity goes unnoticed.

extended_description.applicability: Spaces and assets whose protection depends on noticing unauthorized presence or activity, including entrances, corridors, perimeters, sensitive areas and individual high-value assets. Observation may rely on cameras, detectors, alarms or people. The level of monitoring required depends on the sensitivity of what is protected.
extended_description.exploitation: An unauthorized person enters or acts inside the facility without being stopped, because the space or asset is not observed, the signals are not detected, or no one acts on them.

row.details: Unauthorized presence and activity are not seen, or are seen too late.
Information, media and equipment can be viewed or removed unnoticed.
Equipment can be altered or tampered with unnoticed.

row.description: Identify the spaces and assets that need observation according to their sensitivity, including corridors and approaches.
Use cameras, detectors or patrols so that each identified space or asset is observed.
Make sure signals reach someone who is able to act on them.
Protect monitoring devices and their recordings against tampering.
Test periodically, including at night and outside business hours.
Monitoring of people, notably video surveillance, is regulated. Define purpose, retention and notification in accordance with applicable law.

row.reference: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-6 Monitoring Physical Access
ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Annex A: 7.4 Physical security monitoring
